title: 第一章  这开局人麻了！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“扑通！”

公主府，内湖炸开一朵水花。

岸上灯火通明，丫鬟仆役举着火把围了一圈，个个伸长了脖子往湖里瞅。

“捞上来了，捞上来了！”

“快快快，活的死的？”

“还有口气儿呢，就是模样忒惨了些....”

“管他的，敢背着公主偷情，死一万次也弥补不了他的罪孽...”

众人七嘴八舌，手上可是一点不耽误，拖着林澈就又往猪笼里塞...

林澈猛地睁开眼，一口水呛出来，喉咙里火辣辣地疼。

视线还没对焦，就看见一大片花花绿绿的古装衣摆在自己跟前晃悠。

火把的光把人的影子拉得老长，跟一群要吃人的妖怪。

不远处，还躺着一个丫鬟打扮的姑娘，面色青白。

林澈脑子里“嗡”的一声。

他低头一看自己....

好家伙，竹条编的猪笼，凉丝丝地箍在身上，整个人像条待宰的鱼。

几个膀大腰圆的壮汉正拽着猪笼往湖边拖，看那架势是要把他沉湖了。

林澈差点气笑了。

他在蓝星是什么人？

特种部队出来的兵王，刀山火海里滚三滚，站着撒尿的主！

现在倒好，穿过来第一件事是被人装猪笼？

这也太跌份儿了！

正想发作，脑子里突然“轰”地一下爆开，乱七八糟的记忆碎片疯狂往里灌...

大夏朝，公主府，驸马爷。

跟他同名，也叫林澈。

原主是镇国公的庶子，三年前走了狗屎运被太后看中，招为驸马，一跃成了皇家的上门女婿。

按理说这是多少人做梦都不敢想的好事，可这位驸马爷性情软弱又清高，跟公主殿下别说琴瑟和鸣了，连话都说不上几句。

夫妻三年，愣是没圆房。

不是不想，是公主不乐意，他也不敢硬来。

两个人就这么尴尴尬尬地在一个屋檐下住了三年！

是那种互相看不顺眼连打招呼都费劲的关系！

今晚这出戏，是有人设局....

说林澈与丫鬟私通，被人当场撞破。

林澈百口莫辩，一头扎进湖里想以死明志。

结果人没死透，倒是把林澈这个异世魂魄给招来了。

理清楚前因后果那一瞬间，林澈的第一反应不是愤怒，不是害怕，而是一种深深的困惑....

这原主，是不是脑子有泡？

这栽赃陷害的手法，堪称粗制滥造。

偏偏原主还真就着了道，被人三言两语激得跳了湖。

林澈深吸一口气，在心里给原主竖了个中指。

行吧，既然老天爷让他借尸还魂，那这烂摊子，他来收。

“公主饶命啊！”

“驸马爷是被人冤枉的，他心里只有公主一人，断不可能跟人私通...”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Plop!"

In the Princess Mansion, a splash of water exploded from the inner lake.

The lights were brightly lit on the shore. The maids and servants held torches and formed a circle. They all stretched their necks to look into the lake.

"Caught it up, caught it!"

"Hurry up, hurry up, live or die?"

"I still have a good tone, but I look a little too miserable..."

"Whatever, if he dares to have an affair behind the princess's back, even if he dies ten thousand times, he won't be able to make up for his sin..."

Everyone was chattering, but their hands wereted no time, dragging Lin Che and stuffing them into the pig cage again...

Lin Che opened her eyes suddenly, choked out a mouthful of water, and felt a burning pain in her throat.

Before his eyes were focused, he saw a large piece of colorful costumes dangling in front of him.

The light of the torch stretched the shadows of people, like a group of monsters that wanted to eat people.

Not far away, there was a girl dressed as a maid lying with a pale complexion.

Lin Che's head buzzed.

He looked down at himself...

Good guy, the pig cage made of bamboo strips is wrapped around the body like a fish waiting to be slaughtered.

Several strong men with big shoulders and round waists were dragging the pig cage towards the lake, looking like they were about to sink it into the lake.

Lin Che almost laughed angrily.

Who is he in Blue Star?

The king of soldiers from the special forces, rolling in mountains of swords and seas of fire, and the master of peeing while standing!

It's good now. The first thing you do when you come here is to be put in a pig cage?

This is too low!

Just when I was about to have an attack, my brain suddenly exploded with a "boom", and random memory fragments were crazily poured into it...

The Great Xia Dynasty, the princess's mansion, the prince-in-law.

The same name as him is also called Lin Che.

The original owner was the concubine of the Duke of Zhen. Three years ago, he got lucky and was spotted by the Queen Mother. She recruited him as her consort and became the royal son-in-law.

It stands to reason that this is a good thing that many people would never dream of, but this prince-in-law has a weak and aloof temperament, and he can't even exchange a few words with Her Royal Highness the Princess, let alone the harmony of music and music.

The couple had been married for three years, but they didn't consummate their marriage.

It's not that he doesn't want to, it's that the princess is not happy, and he doesn't dare to force it.

The two of them lived awkwardly under the same roof for three years!

It’s the kind of relationship where it’s hard to even say hello to each other if they don’t like each other!

Tonight's drama was set up by someone...

It was said that Lin Che was having an affair with the maid and was discovered on the spot.

Lin Che couldn't argue, so she jumped into the lake and wanted to die to prove her ambition.

In the end, the person was not completely dead, but Lin Che, a soul from another world, was summoned.

The moment she figured out the cause and effect, Lin Che's first reaction was not anger or fear, but a deep confusion...

Is this original owner out of his mind?

This method of frame-up can be called shoddy.

However, the original owner really took the bait and jumped into the lake because of a few words.

Lin Che took a deep breath and mentally gave the original owner a middle finger.

Okay, since God asked him to resurrect the corpse, he will clean up this mess.

"Princess, please spare your life!"

"The prince-in-law was wrongly accused. He only has the princess in his heart, and there is no way he would have an affair with someone..."
